note: FCEUX segfaulted (rc 139) after emu.exit, once the .sav was already written; every run did this. The game showed its save message (データ1 ... セーブしています) and returned to the menu, but FCEUX wrote a 0-byte .sav: its mapper 16 (LZ93D50 + 24C02 EEPROM) code does not persist the EEPROM for this NES 2.0 dump. fceumm and mesen write 256 bytes. Filed as the real (empty) file.
